Read the curve fits delivered by PRISM

Source: R/prism_drc.R
read_PRISM_drc.Rd

Reads a PRISM dose-response table (the DRC_TABLE of an MTS or EPS delivery), with one row per curve PRISM fitted. The cell line identifier and Duration are added in the form convert_LEVEL5_prism_to_gDR_input gives them, so the curves can be matched to the processed data, e.g. by gDRcore::add_PRISM_metrics(), which adds them to the Metrics assay as a second fit source.

Usage

read_PRISM_drc(drc_path, meta_data_path = NULL)

Arguments

drc_path

string, path to the PRISM DRC table (CSV).

meta_data_path

string, path to the DepMap Model.csv that maps depmap_id to the CCLE name (the file given to convert_LEVEL5_prism_to_gDR_input()). Not needed when the table has a ccle_name column.

Value

data.table with the columns of the DRC table, the cell line identifier (the CCLE name, under the name of the cellline identifier) and Duration in hours (day * 24). Rows whose depmap_id has no CCLE name in Model.csv get NA, as they are left out of the LEVEL5 import. The input files are recorded in the attribute read by get_import_provenance.

Details

PRISM fits upper_limit + (lower_limit - upper_limit) / (1 + (dose / inflection)^slope); the table is returned as delivered, without any change to these values.

Examples

curves <- read_PRISM_drc(
  drc_path = system.file("testdata/prism_drc.csv", package = "gDRimport"),
  meta_data_path = system.file("testdata/prism_drc_model.csv", package = "gDRimport")
)
curves[, c("clid", "Duration", "pert_name", "lower_limit", "upper_limit", "slope", "inflection")]
#>                                           clid Duration pert_name lower_limit
#>                                         <char>    <num>    <char>       <num>
#> 1:      HEL_HAEMATOPOIETIC_AND_LYMPHOID_TISSUE      120    G00106        0.21
#> 2:  HEL9217_HAEMATOPOIETIC_AND_LYMPHOID_TISSUE      120    G00106        0.35
#> 3:  HEL9217_HAEMATOPOIETIC_AND_LYMPHOID_TISSUE      120    G00106        0.29
#> 4: MONOMAC6_HAEMATOPOIETIC_AND_LYMPHOID_TISSUE      120    G00106          NA
#>    upper_limit slope inflection
#>          <num> <num>      <num>
#> 1:        0.98  -1.4       0.85
#> 2:        1.01  -0.9       2.40
#> 3:        0.96  -1.1       1.70
#> 4:          NA    NA         NA
